# Christian T. Macion — Portfolio

> Christian T. Macion is a Quantitative Researcher and AI Engineer in Digos City, Philippines (UTC+8). He builds reproducible public-data systematic research, evaluation-first AI systems, and production engineering artifacts. Open to remote QR and research-engineering roles with US pre-market or APAC overlap. Contact: [/contact](/contact).
>
> The public surface is NDA-safe by construction: no proprietary data, strategy internals, or desk PnL are published. For the full generated text of every public HTML route, read [/llms-full.txt](/llms-full.txt).

## Signature open-source repos

- [eval-mcp-server](https://github.com/christianmacion26/eval-mcp-server) — MCP server over the slop gate; 20/20 conformance.
- [rag-recall](https://github.com/christianmacion26/rag-recall) — retrieval scorecard; recall@3 = 0.886, MRR@3 = 0.805.
- [multiple-testing-deflated-sharpe](https://github.com/christianmacion26/multiple-testing-deflated-sharpe) — DSR applied to a 160-rule BTC sweep.
- [toolcall-agent](https://github.com/christianmacion26/toolcall-agent) — ReAct agent with OTel and fault injection.
- [judge-harness](https://github.com/christianmacion26/judge-harness) — LLM-as-judge with Cohen's kappa and bootstrap CI.
- [reflect-revise](https://github.com/christianmacion26/reflect-revise) — reflection-loop agent with an honest no-progress halt.
- [slop-scanner](https://github.com/christianmacion26/slop-scanner) — 13-metric standard-library quality gate.
- [cross-sectional-momentum](https://github.com/christianmacion26/cross-sectional-momentum) — out-of-sample cross-sectional momentum study.
- [timeseries-momentum-voltarget](https://github.com/christianmacion26/timeseries-momentum-voltarget) — volatility-targeting study.
- [variance-risk-premium](https://github.com/christianmacion26/variance-risk-premium) — implied versus realized volatility study.
- [pairs-cointegration](https://github.com/christianmacion26/pairs-cointegration) — BTC/ETH cointegration study.
- [funding-carry](https://github.com/christianmacion26/funding-carry) — perpetual-funding carry study.
- [macro-regime-overlay](https://github.com/christianmacion26/macro-regime-overlay) — regime-overlay study.
- [backtest-engine-costs](https://github.com/christianmacion26/backtest-engine-costs) — gross-versus-net cost study.
- [lookahead-bias-audit](https://github.com/christianmacion26/bias-audit) — lookahead-bias audit.
